query:
INSERT INTO users (email, full_name, google_id, avatar_url, role)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'customer')
        ON CONFLICT (email) 
        DO UPDATE SET 
            google_id = EXCLUDED.google_id,
            avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url,
            updated_at = NOW()
        RETURNING id, full_name, role
